summary.text: Aurora lights are multicolored lights whose dense materialization forms flowing light fruits.

claims.text: Flowing light fruits do not grow on plants or trees. They are a pure materialization of dense aurora lights. Aurora lights have many colors, and so do the fruits: red, brown, yellow, green, black, blue, purple, and more.

When flowing light fruits self-detonate, they rapidly form into aurora lights that fill the sky in many colors. The essence of those fruits is condensed aurora light. Fang Yuan detonates eighty percent of a batch and lets the remaining twenty percent float in the vast aurora lights to nourish them. He plans to bring in large numbers of dazzling light Gu so the aurora lights can grow; that Gu can erupt with red aurora lights and needs scorching swan stones as food. Dazzling light Gu is only the simplest method to produce aurora lights and is not very effective.
Using aurora lights of flowing light fruits for other planting would ruin flowing light fruit plans, because light is used up and those aurora lights then have no source.

A small field of aurora lights sits in Mini Orange Heaven, with many floating flowing light fruits inside. Light path Gu worms taken from a jade light pit go into the aurora lights in the nine heavens, and that haul expands the scale of both the aurora lights and the fruits on their earlier foundation.

Fang Yuan first relies on aurora light and buys large numbers of dazzling light Gu to increase aurora light in the immortal aperture: the more intense the aurora light, the more flowing light fruits can form, and Attitude Gu feeds on those fruits. Light shine fungus is a desolate plant that provides light unlike multicolored aurora light, yet wood path methods might modify it into aurora light shine fungi. Jade light pit plunder already replenishes light needs for aurora lights even before that modification succeeds.

Mini Orange Heaven holds a field of aurora lights, and within them are flowing light fruits. Modified pure white light shine fungi make the aurora lights start to expand, mildly at first but substantially over time. Aurora lights need intense lights, and the floating fungi help those areas. Developing that field is meant to satisfy the food requirements of Attitude Gu.
Fang Yuan keeps watching Mini Orange Heaven as the light shine fungi make the aurora lights expand rapidly and nurture more flowing light fruits within.

In immemorial white heaven, aurora lights move dazzlingly in the air. Qing Hui Zi retrieves them with immortal killer moves, gathers the rainbow lights into balls, buries the balls in cloud soil, and waters the seedlings with lightning water and magnetic sound until flowing light fruits grow. Aurora lights are very common in the two heavens and are produced abundantly. Collecting them himself lowers his cost of producing flowing light fruits.
